# Stop Using This

> The recall, the fix, nothing else. Every number is quoted from an official page (linked on each page); computations are shown as arithmetic. Narration uses an AI voice.

## Data pages (dated records from official sources, each linked)

- [recalls.html](https://d0nd1.github.io/signalforge-data/stop-using-this/recalls.html)
- [feed.xml](https://d0nd1.github.io/signalforge-data/stop-using-this/feed.xml) (Atom feed of new verified items)
